svg.title: Safety-filter geometry: straight corridor versus implemented arc-clearance filter
svg.desc: (a) Schematic of where each filter measures clearance before capping speed. (b) Crash-rate difference arc-clearance minus riskcap for 15 seed-density cells: pooled −1.4903 pp, 95% CI [−1.8981, −1.0826], seed-level 95% CI [−2.42, −0.57] over 3 evaluation seeds; 15/15 cells below zero, and the cells are not independent replicates. Frozen policy F. Configured contrast in simulation; no collision-safety guarantee.
